thread:
julia: Quick note 1 new hire Mei (intl) hit onboarding snags: passport upload error (kiosk says corrupted) + background-check email bounced. Start date Fri. Need contingency plan.

omar: Can we manual-upload from our side if she emails docs? Also BG vendor bounce means email wrong or spam filter.

hrbot: Check policy: remote-i9 allows passport if unexpired. If portal rejects, teams can accept scanned passport + selfie uploaded to onboarding mailbox and ppl-ops will sanitize & upload.

onboard-bot: action: send-mei-instructions -> "Please retake photo with phone, save as jpg, filename use only ascii, and email to onboarding@redwood.example. If BG email bounced, confirm email used for background vendor."

julia: I DM'ed Mei to confirm which email she used for background-check. Also asked to resend docs to onboarding mailbox.

itbot: Received attachments: passport_scan.jpg (3.2MB) + selfie.jpg (1.1MB). Attempting portal upload... portal rejected -> "image encoding not supported".

omar: Try converting server-side. Use `magick passport_scan.jpg -strip -interlace Plane -quality 85 passport_sanitized.pdf` then upload.

itbot: Converted and uploaded as PDF. Portal accepted passport. BG vendor still shows bounce.

finance-bot: FYI: payroll needs local tax id for several countries. If missing, payroll will apply statutory withholding. We'll follow up once BG vendor confirms identity.

julia: For continuity, propose provisional start Friday with limited access (non-prod only) until BG and I-9 cleared. Hiring manager ok. Security please approve scoped access.

itbot: Security approved scoped non-prod access. Created ticket `onboard-provisional-2654321987` with 14-day provisional window.

onboard-bot: calendar: Day-1 orientation invite sent to mei@example.com, buddy assigned: omar.

julia: Final step  once BG vendor confirms, update payroll / benefits enrollment. Mei please check spam for the vendor email and confirm receipt.

omar: Thx all. I'll monitor BG vendor and assist Mei with email issues. Closing thread unless something else pops up. :white_check_mark:
